Font audit M/replace/core.gfx: hoi_16mbs L1415/color1421, hoi_18mbs L1554/color1558, hoi_20b L1595/color1602, hoi_20bs L1632/color1639 and bsm_16 L2517/color2522 are white. hoi4_typewriter16 L1684/color1689 and hoi4_typewriter22 L1770/color1775 are already black; do not invert them blindly. hoi_22tech L2098/color2102 and hoi_33 L2157/color2162 are deliberately translucent white (0x44ffffff) and need separate label/watermark treatment. Header white stays on navy; body white changes only on proven light chrome.

Preserve GFX_tiled_window_transparent and other invisible layout/hit-target backgrounds: making them opaque can cover dynamic pictures and intercept or obscure layered content. Thin frame central holes must remain transparent; dimensions/frame counts alone are insufficient.

Only pure blank GFX_tab_large and GFX_battle_log_tab were visually checked and selected as tabs. War globe/special-forces star/service branch tabs are nonblank and preserved. Generic close/scroll controls are handled by sibling custom.json special roles, not blanked by this manifest.

No game startup or UI interaction was performed for this read-only inventory; native texture contact sheets were inspected in temporary files only. Existing shared/dedicated Win95 sprite references must not be regenerated.

Separate selection sprite IDs GFX_fleet_bg_hl / GFX_task_force_bg_hl are each one frame. Render their row with a distinct navy outline on a light face; otherwise generic row generation makes selected and unselected states identical. The three-colour theatre_naval_control_panel remains protected because service/state semantics were not proven safe to flatten.

2026-10-30 material finish review supersedes the blanket alpha-preservation rule for the 27 explicit material_profiles. Profiles declare complete rectangular edges and true picture openings; source geometry, frame count and shaders stay unchanged. Event caption/minimize layout additions are documented in material_finish.json.
